scenes.onscreen_text: Am I ever going to see that money again?
scenes.voiceover: Let's be honest... am I ever going to see that money again?
scenes.visual: Victor slumps at his desk, skeptically eyeing a dusty cobwebbed PAST DUE invoice beside an empty coin jar.

scenes.onscreen_text: Your first recovery - posted to your account.
scenes.voiceover: Then it happens — your first recovery, posted straight to your account.
scenes.visual: A glowing green PAYMENT RECEIVED banner pulses as Victor springs up in a fangs-out grin; golden coins rain down and the jar overflows.

scenes.onscreen_text: That money isn't gone. It's just waiting. / Just email info@swrecovery.com
scenes.voiceover: That money isn't gone — it's just waiting. Email info@swrecovery.com.
scenes.visual: Energized Victor slides a fresh stack of PAST DUE invoices into the glowing email envelope; it lifts off; thumbs-up beside the full coin jar.

scenes.onscreen_text: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think. / Email your placements to info@swrecovery.com
scenes.visual: Navy SWRS-color end card (Fira Sans) with the official white SWRS logo held top-center, silent reveal.
